title: In Christ Alone
lyrics_original: In Christ alone my hope is found,
He is my light, my strength, my song
This Cornerstone, this solid Ground
Firm through the fiercest drought and storm.
What heights of love, what depths of peace
When fears are stilled, when strivings cease
My Comforter, my All in All
Here in the love of Christ I stand.
In Christ alone! – who took on flesh,
Fullness of God in helpless babe.
This gift of love and righteousness,
Scorned by the ones He came to save
Till on that cross as Jesus died,
The wrath of God was satisfied
For every sin on Him was laid
Here in the death of Christ I live.
There in the ground His body lay,
Light of the world by darkness slain:
Then bursting forth in glorious day
Up from the grave He rose again
And as He stands in victory
Sin's curse has lost its grip on me,
For I am His and He is mine
Bought with the precious blood of Christ
No guilt in life, no fear in death,
This is the power of Christ in me
From life's first cry to final breath,
Jesus commands my destiny
No power of hell, no scheme of man,
Can ever pluck me from His hand
Till He returns or calls me home
Here in the power of Christ I'll stand.

bible_verses.telugu: మరి ఎవనివలనను రక్షణ కలుగదు; ఈ నామముననే మనము రక్షణ పొందవలెను గాని, ఆకాశము క్రింద మనుష్యులలో ఇయ్యబడిన మరి ఏ నామమున రక్షణ పొందలేము అనెను.
bible_verses.english: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved.

bible_verses.telugu: క్రీస్తుయేసే ముఖ్యమైన మూలరాయియై యుండగా అపొస్తలులును ప్రవక్తలును వేసిన పునాదిమీద మీరు కట్టబడియున్నారు.
bible_verses.english: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the chief cornerstone.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన అన్నిటికంటె ముందుగా ఉన్న వాడు; ఆయనే సమస్తమునకు ఆధారభూతుడు.
bible_verses.english: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my unshakable foundation when the storms of life roar around me. In You alone, I find the peace, hope, and strength I need for today. Forgive me for trying to carry burdens in my own strength, and help me to rest in Your complete love. Stand with me, Lord, and be my All in All. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my unshakable foundation when the storms of life roar around me. In You alone, I find the peace, hope, and strength I need for today. devotional.reflection_english: In a world that constantly shifts beneath our feet, "In Christ Alone" reminds us where our true security lies. Jesus isn't just a distant helper; He is our solid ground, our light in dark seasons, and the quiet peace that stills our deepest anxieties. As we contemplate His incredible humility in taking on human flesh for us, our hearts are invited to surrender every striving and fear. May you rest today in the unwavering love of the One who holds all things together.
